title: Semantic infrastructure as practice: priority terms and projected uptake
description: These claims treat the archive's writing as semantic infrastructure and record its terms: priority records for Non-Trick Semantic Infrastructure, Metric-Bearing versus Metric-Mimicking Output, Autonomous Semantic Warfare and machine-mediated resistance literature. Forecasts project uptake, from Rex Fraction's consulting practice and Destiny's co-authorship surfacing in a 2030 summary to the projected citations of the Ghost Meaning atlas. Dodecad anti-capture safeguards, Semantic Samizdat's admitted lack of a confirmed member and MPAI reception signatures for Rebekah Cranes and Alexanarch complete the page.

Will have coined "bearing-cost citation" — the DOI as anti-Goodhart mechanism.
